title: guidonia cupulata
intro: Guidonia cupulata, commonly known as the golden cup, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is native to the tropical forests of Central and South America, where it is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Guidonia cupulata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and prevent infections.
